text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I gave in to sweet temptation and ended
up
getting dessert.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Lately, whenever I skip practice, I end
up
snacking, and now my clothes are
feeling tight...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Sei! You about to have
lunch? Mind if
I join you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sure. Oh, see that dessert on the table?
Go
ahead and help yourself.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sure am. Just a little something to say
thanks for
everything you've done for
me recently. ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm the one who should be thanking you. Drool...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, seeing you eat that up like it's
the most
delicious thing in the whole
world...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I think it'll fill both my heart and my
belly right
up.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What I'm getting at is... I'm looking
forward to
doing this a whole bunch
more!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What? You're planning on giving me
even more?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yippee! Keep the dessert coming forever
and
ever! ...Uh, I mean, let's keep
helping each other
out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By lunching with Special Week for a
time, Seiun
Sky manages to stick to her
diet.
